scope: Architecture-only research extension for Apple-native LLM acceleration; 13 selected methods; no personal hardware inventory.
coverage: Bounded primary-source survey with method-level reading for highlighted semantics and source inspection for ReDrafter's MLX path. Not exhaustive or a ranking of current fastest methods.
source_policy: Primary papers, author pages and author repositories. Abstract-level evidence is labeled; author measurements are distinct from reproduced measurements.
access_notes: Web access verified paper and repository identities. Some GitHub web file/tree requests failed with cache misses; GitHub connector successfully retrieved selected ReDrafter MLX source files and blob identities.
Repository links without immutable commit references are mutable. The three ReDrafter Git blob hashes identify inspected file content; they are not repository commit hashes.

studies.title: Recurrent Drafter for Fast Speculative Decoding in Large Language Models
studies.evidence: Paper abstract, Apple overview, repository README, MLX experiment notes and selected MLX source functions inspected.
studies.mechanism: Distilled recurrent drafter conditioned on target hidden states; beam verification and prefix acceptance.
studies.adaptation: Train a compatible auxiliary drafter and implement feature, tokenizer, attention-mask and cache contracts.
studies.apple_evidence: Authors report MLX/Metal experiments; no experiment reproduced here. Older repository notes and paper maximum describe different conditions.
limits: README warns non-greedy implementation may not preserve exact target distribution.
Inspected MLX verifier retains TODO for tree compression and position IDs; do not equate the full paper algorithm with this branch.
Repository default-branch files are mutable; Git blob identities below identify inspected content.

studies.title: EAGLE-3: Scaling up Inference Acceleration of Large Language Models via Training-Time Test
studies.evidence: Primary abstract and author repository identity inspected; no implementation audit.
studies.mechanism: Direct token objective and multi-layer target-feature fusion improve learned draft proposals.
studies.adaptation: Target-specific draft training, feature access and efficient verification.
limits: Published speedups are author measurements, not reproduced Apple results.
Training benefit does not establish latency benefit after backend integration.

studies.title: Medusa: Simple LLM Inference Acceleration Framework with Multiple Decoding Heads
studies.evidence: Paper methods including section 2.3.1 and author repository identity inspected.
studies.mechanism: Future-token heads share a backbone; tree attention verifies candidate continuations.
studies.adaptation: Train heads alone or jointly with the backbone, then implement tree verification and state updates.
limits: Typical acceptance is distinct from distribution-preserving rejection sampling.
Medusa-2 changes the target backbone; comparison against the original target needs quality evaluation.

studies.title: LayerSkip: Enabling Early Exit Inference and Self-Speculative Decoding
studies.evidence: Paper training, self-speculation and experiment descriptions inspected; repository identity verified.
studies.mechanism: Training makes early exits useful; draft and verifier share layers, activations and KV state.
studies.adaptation: Adapted checkpoint plus a runtime that reuses early-layer work.
limits: Reported paper inference experiments use greedy decoding.
Early exit without full verification can change accuracy.
No Apple implementation or performance result verified.

studies.title: Break the Sequential Dependency of LLM Inference Using Lookahead Decoding
studies.evidence: Primary paper Jacobi, n-gram pool and verification sections inspected; author repository identity verified.
studies.mechanism: Generate candidate n-grams through parallel updates and verify continuations without an auxiliary trained model.
studies.adaptation: Candidate pool, attention masks and correct target verification; no model training required.
limits: Extra arithmetic must be economical for the chosen backend and concurrency.
Paper exactness claim is not runtime validation of a future port.

studies.title: Mirror Speculative Decoding: Breaking the Serial Barrier in LLM Inference
studies.evidence: Apple overview, paper scheduling description and hardware appendix inspected.
studies.mechanism: Overlap early-signal draft rollouts with target suffix execution across heterogeneous accelerators.
studies.adaptation: Trained compatible components and asynchronous scheduling with correct cross-processor state and acceptance.
limits: No author implementation repository was established in this bounded review.

Hardware appendix describes eight M2 Ultra systems linked using Thunderbolt 5. Apple's stock 2023 Mac Studio specification lists Thunderbolt 4. The source does not resolve this setup ambiguity; no inference of intent is made.
Reported speedups are not used as validated Apple evidence.

studies.title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration
studies.evidence: Primary abstract and author repository identity inspected; prior co-design chapter covers MLX-LM route.
studies.mechanism: Activation statistics select channel scaling that protects low-bit weight quality.
studies.adaptation: Calibration and backend-compatible quantized packing/kernels; original method does not require backpropagation.
limits: Original publication 2023; inspected arXiv revision is v6 from 2026.
TinyChat speedups cannot be assigned to an arbitrary Apple conversion.

studies.title: QuaRot: Outlier-Free 4-Bit Inference in Rotated LLMs
studies.evidence: Primary paper abstract and author repository identity inspected; no kernel implementation audit.
studies.mechanism: Equivalent rotations reduce outliers before weight, activation and KV quantization.
studies.adaptation: Compatible transformed graph, quantization and efficient runtime rotation/low-bit operators.
limits: Equivalent unquantized transformation does not make the later quantization exact.
No Apple runtime compatibility or speedup verified.

studies.title: KIVI: A Tuning-Free Asymmetric 2bit Quantization for KV Cache
studies.evidence: Primary abstract and author README mechanism inspected.
studies.mechanism: Different quantization grouping for keys and values reduces persistent attention state.
studies.adaptation: Packed cache layout, metadata, incremental updates and efficient attention kernels; no model fine-tuning.
limits: Cache quantization is approximate and requires task-quality checks.
Reported throughput benefits include increased feasible batch size.
No Apple benchmark reproduced.

studies.title: LLM in a flash: Efficient Large Language Model Inference with Limited Memory
studies.evidence: Primary paper predictor, windowing, bundling and evaluation sections inspected.
studies.mechanism: Predict active neurons, cache recent required rows and coalesce flash reads.
studies.adaptation: Suitable sparse/adapted model, trained activation predictors and storage/cache implementation.
limits: No author implementation repository established in this bounded review.
Prediction errors can change model quality.
Naive storage-loading baseline is not equivalent to fully resident inference.

studies.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
studies.evidence: Primary abstract and author repository identity inspected.
studies.mechanism: Reduce non-matrix work and communication while improving attention work partitioning and occupancy.
studies.adaptation: Metal-specific threadgroup, SIMD and tile implementation; no checkpoint retraining.
limits: CUDA warp and A100 utilization choices are not Apple tuning prescriptions.
Exact attention semantics do not imply bitwise identical floating-point outputs.
This review does not audit the evolving repository's later FlashAttention versions.

studies.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
studies.evidence: Primary abstract and author repository identity inspected.
studies.mechanism: Logical-to-physical KV block mapping reduces fragmentation and supports sharing.
studies.adaptation: Application allocator, sequence mappings, ownership and paged attention kernels; no training.
limits: KV paging does not mean operating-system swap.
Serving throughput gain is not an equal isolated-request latency gain.
No claim that current vLLM features all exist in an Apple engine.

studies.title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
studies.evidence: Primary abstract and author repository identity inspected.
studies.mechanism: Program-aware execution, RadixAttention state reuse and compressed state machines for structured generation.
studies.adaptation: Runtime/program interface, correct prefix-cache identity and constrained decoding integration; no training.
limits: Benefit depends on workload repetition and constraints.
Constrained generation changes allowed continuations.
Evolving repository is not treated as a fully audited Apple backend.
